messages:
mia-cs: Quick alert — several customers hit failures during bulk tenant imports starting ~03:10 UTC. They see immediate `429` and some report webhook retries failing. Affected list attached. Need customer-facing status ASAP.
owen-eng: Looking. Surface-level: import concurrency + a throttling rule triggered by shared token budget. We can throttle per-tenant + queue heavy imports. Rolling change ETA ~25m.
leah-cs: Can we send a short note that reassures customers and offers hands-on help? We should prioritize renewals and pilot customers.
mia-cs: Draft I want to send in 10m: 
---
Hi — were aware of errors impacting bulk onboarding/imports (some jobs returning "rate limit" errors). Our engineers are rolling a fix and we expect normal operations within ~30 minutes. Were reducing import concurrency and isolating heavy imports to reduce retries.
If your import failed and youd like help, reply here and well prioritize a support session. Well follow up with an RCA and account credit if you were impacted.
— Redwood Inference CS
---
sam-ops: I can immediately move queued imports into a low-concurrency worker and issue provisional credits for verified failures. Billing will finalize later.
owen-eng: Patch at 30% rollout, error rate on route down ~60% in early telemetry. Still watching fallback paths to embeddings service.
leah-cs: Ill triage the list and start targeted outreach to top 5 accounts. Will include calendar links for a live import session.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-28346 opened and paging owеn-eng oncall.
mia-cs: Thanks. Action items: leah-cs outreach + log collection; sam-ops prepare provisional credit entries; owen-eng confirm when route errors reach near-zero. I'll publish the status message once leah approves the wording. :thumbsup:
